cameras.capability_notes: Live V4L2 probe: only 640x480 YUYV advertised; no zoom control exposed. Current capture uses the full delivered frame without digital cropping.

exposure_notes: Curtains closed: automatic exposure and white balance, 50 Hz compensation. Wrist camera physically rotated and tilted; no software rotation. Latest live view confirms both fingertips and the gap are visible near the bottom. Overhead view covers robot, objects and more of the tabletop.
placement_status: Approximate object/overhead visual fit saved in config/scene.json; arm pose and wrist mounting transform provisional pending motor and camera calibration.
